huaian-1.name: Zhou Enlai's Former Residence
huaian-1.bio: Childhood home of Zhou Enlai, who was born here in 1898 and lived here for his first twelve years.

huaian-2.name: Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall
huaian-2.bio: Exhibitions on the life and work of Zhou Enlai, set in his home city of Huai'an.
huaian-2.notes: Possible booking requirement (needs: booking) from web-search summary of Ctrip, not verified; orchestrator may decide. Described as national 5A scenic area, opened 1992 (search summary, unverified). Possible free WeChat booking (needs: booking) unconfirmed.

huaian-3.name: Hexia Old Town
huaian-3.bio: Canal-side old town of stone-paved lanes and brick-and-timber houses laid out in the Ming and Qing eras.
huaian-3.notes: Free entry is only from Trip.com traveller listings via search, not an official source; wiki title corrected to 'Hexia Ancient Town' (en Wikipedia page exists, not fetched in full). Name in shard is 'Hexia Old Town'. Free is guide-level (Trip.com), not official.
huaian-3.held: no sourced cost: free/open rests only on a Trip.com review page that does not mention admission

huaian-4.name: Wu Cheng'en's Former Residence
huaian-4.bio: Home of Ming-dynasty writer Wu Cheng'en, author of Journey to the West, in Datong Lane in Hexia.

huaian-5.name: China Water Transport Museum
huaian-5.bio: Museum on Huai'an's role in shipping grain along the Grand Canal to the imperial capital.
huaian-5.notes: Wikivoyage lastedit 2018; a search summary mentions possible Monday closure.

huaian-6.name: Huai'an Government House
huaian-6.bio: One of very few surviving prefectural yamen in China, first built in 1370 and restored after fires.

huaian-7.name: Zhenhuai Building
huaian-7.bio: Tower over the old Huai River city gate, rebuilt in the 19th century, with a small museum inside.

huaian-8.name: Iris Chang Memorial Hall
huaian-8.bio: Memorial to Iris Chang, author of The Rape of Nanking, with exhibitions on her life and the Nanjing Massacre.

huaian-9.name: Huai'an Museum
huaian-9.bio: City museum on the history and culture of Huai'an, in Qingjiangpu District.
huaian-9.notes: Free per Wikivoyage (2018). ticketUrl unverified (dead link): http://www.hamuseum.com

huaian-10.name: Journey to the West Amusement Park
huaian-10.bio: Theme park built around the characters and stories of Wu Cheng'en's novel Journey to the West.
huaian-10.notes: Price from Wikivoyage edit 2024-02; Ctrip listing via search shows deals from ~124 (aggregator, not used). ticketUrl BLOCKED: https://www.haxyjt.com

huaian-11.name: Huai'an Zoo
huaian-11.bio: City zoo founded in 1958 and moved to its present site in 2012, with imported and native animals.

huaian-12.name: Zhou Enlai's Childhood School
huaian-12.bio: Family school where Zhou Enlai studied as a child with his brother and two sisters.

suqian-1.name: Xiang Yu's Ancestral Home
suqian-1.bio: Hometown of Xiang Yu, with a temple, a statue and an ancient battlefield on Huanghe South Road.

suqian-2.name: Luoma Lake
suqian-2.bio: Large freshwater lake on the Grand Canal northwest of Suqian, with wetland, fishing and a tourist resort.
suqian-2.notes: No price in any source (resort price blank on Wikivoyage); cost held. Lake itself likely open access but unsourced.

suqian-3.name: Santaishan Forest Park
suqian-3.bio: National forest park on the shore of Luoma Lake in Hubin New District, in Suyu District.
suqian-3.notes: Wikivoyage price '20-60' (range, likely by area/season); no agency park pass applies (China). Park's own gate fee. Price range 20-60 per Wikivoyage.

suqian-4.name: Suqian Museum
suqian-4.bio: City museum on Suqian's history, customs, economic development and folk art.
suqian-4.notes: Price blank on Wikivoyage; cost held.

sihong-ancient-xucheng.name: Sihong Ancient Xucheng Scenic Area
sihong-ancient-xucheng.bio: Scenic area on the heritage of the ancient Xu Kingdom, in the Southern New City of Sihong County.
sihong-ancient-xucheng.notes: Price blank; cost held. Hours (daily to 22:00) deliberately not recorded.

hongze-lake-wetland-park.name: Hongze Lake Wetland Park
hongze-lake-wetland-park.bio: Nature reserve in the northwest of Hongze Lake, the largest freshwater wetland reserve in Jiangsu.
hongze-lake-wetland-park.notes: Candidate price 60 yuan (+ shuttle 30-200) from maigoo.com encyclopaedia page, undated, not Wikivoyage: https://www.maigoo.com/citiao/113126.html; not used. Reported as national 5A scenic area, 240 bird species (news.cn 2026-08, via search summary). 'Hongze Lake' en Wikipedia article is the lake, so wiki null.

xuzhou-1.name: Lion Hill Han Tombs
xuzhou-1.bio: Western Han tomb of a Chu king on Lion Hill, with a nearby museum of over 5,000 terracotta warriors.
xuzhou-1.notes: Admission CNY 90 is a combined ticket for the Han Culture Scenic Area (Chu King's tomb, Terracotta Warriors Museum, Zhulin Temple, Han stone gallery). Wikivoyage updated Feb 2018; chinatripedia same figure. Bio draft says 'Western Han royal tomb of the Chu princes with terracotta army': ok. CNY 90 is a combined ticket for the Han Culture Scenic Area.

xuzhou-2.name: Xuzhou Museum
xuzhou-2.bio: Museum founded in 1959 on a former Qianlong palace site, which also runs Xuzhou's Han tomb sites.
xuzhou-2.notes: Wikipedia gives http://www.xzmuseum.com/eindex.aspx as official site; script fetch returns status 0 (unreachable) so unverified. Wikivoyage flags its own link dead. Bio draft says 'Han jade burial suits': not confirmed by fetched sources, writer should use sourced facts only. ticketUrl BLOCKED: http://www.xzmuseum.com/eindex.aspx

xuzhou-3.name: Yunlong Lake
xuzhou-3.bio: Large lake in southwest Xuzhou with Yunlong Mountain on its east side and the aquarium on Huxin Island.
xuzhou-3.notes: Open lake shore, no gate per sources. Bio draft claims AAAAA rating: not confirmed by fetched sources, omit.

xuzhou-4.name: Yunlong Mountain
xuzhou-4.bio: A 142 m hill of nine dragon-like peaks, with a Song-era crane pavilion; climb on foot or by cable car.
xuzhou-4.notes: Mountain park is free; CNY 4 is only Xinghua Temple (extra inside). Cable car not counted. Xinghua Temple CNY 4 and cable car extra.

xuzhou-5.name: Guishan Han Tombs
xuzhou-5.bio: Rock-cut Western Han tomb of Liu Zhu, sixth king of Chu, with two corridors and five halls.
xuzhou-5.notes: Two guides agree on CNY 80. CNY 80 covers all of Guishan Scenic Area.

xuzhou-6.name: Hubu Hill Ancient Architecture Complex
xuzhou-6.bio: Ming and Qing courtyard houses of officials and merchants on Hubu Hill, two of them holding the Folk Museum.
xuzhou-6.notes: Chinatripedia gives CNY 45 for the complex; Wikivoyage lists Folk Museum alone at CNY 25 and Ximatai CNY 30 (separate). Single guide for 45: moderate confidence.

xuzhou-7.name: Huaihai Campaign Memorial Museum
xuzhou-7.bio: Museum in a large park on the Huaihai Campaign, a major campaign of the Chinese Civil War.

xuzhou-8.name: Han Stone Relief Art Museum
xuzhou-8.bio: Museum of more than 800 Han-dynasty stone sculptures, on the eastern bank of Yunlong Lake.
xuzhou-8.notes: CONFLICT: chinatripedia (current) says free, an undated travelchinaguide page says CNY 30, and Xuzhou Museum runs several sites as free. Recorded free; cost_confidence guide, owner may hold. Cost conflict: free (chinatripedia) vs CNY 30 (older); recorded free. Placement coordinates null.
xuzhou-8.held: cost conflict: Chinatripedia free vs Travel China Guide (updated Jul 2026) CNY 30, and the gallery is in the CNY 90 Han Culture combo

xuzhou-9.name: Quanshan National Forest Park
xuzhou-9.bio: Forest park across the five peaks of Mount Quanshan, with arboretums and China's biggest bird garden.
xuzhou-9.notes: No fee found in any fetched source (only unfetched Qunar/Ctrip review snippets suggesting free, not citable). Hold for cost.

xuzhou-10.name: Xuzhou Aquarium
xuzhou-10.bio: Aquarium on Huxin Island in Yunlong Lake, holding hundreds of aquatic species.
xuzhou-10.notes: Single 2018 listing; stale risk. Placement coordinates null; needs pin.

lianyungang-1.name: Mount Huaguo
lianyungang-1.bio: Mountain said to inspire the Monkey King's home in Journey to the West, topped by Jiangsu's highest peak.
lianyungang-1.notes: Seasonal range; scenic-area shuttle extra. No official site found by search. Seasonal price: CNY 50 Dec-Feb, CNY 90 Mar-Nov.

lianyungang-2.name: Lian Island
lianyungang-2.bio: Jiangsu's largest island, 9 km long and 80% forested, linked to the mainland by a long sea dyke.
lianyungang-2.notes: Guides conflict (another chinatripedia/search snippet says 30 off-season or a CNY 20 transport ticket only; IntoTravelChina combo 120/80). Used 50, peak season. Moderate. Price conflict between guides; used CNY 50 peak season (28 Apr-27 Oct).

lianyungang-3.name: Yuntai Mountain
lianyungang-3.bio: Coastal range of waterfalls and peaks in Lianyungang that includes Mount Huaguo.
lianyungang-3.notes: Wikipedia "Yuntai Mountains" and "Yuntai Mountains (Jiangsu)" both return 404, so wiki null. Off-season price not given. CNY 80 applies 20 Apr-20 Oct; placement wiki title 404, wiki omitted.

lianyungang-4.name: Yuwan Scenic Area
lianyungang-4.bio: Scenic area of waterfalls, rocks and cliffs at the foot of Yuntai Mountain.
lianyungang-4.notes: Single guide source; sparse facts, writer should stay cautious.

lianyungang-5.name: Kongwang Mountain Cliff Carvings
lianyungang-5.bio: Han-dynasty Buddhist cliff carvings among the earliest in China, on a 129 m hill in south Haizhou.
lianyungang-5.notes: No fee in Wikivoyage or any fetched source; Ctrip snippet unreadable. Hold for cost.

lianyungang-6.name: Qinshan Island
lianyungang-6.bio: Sea island off Ganyu, one of 26 small islands along Jiangsu's coast and a national 4A attraction.
lianyungang-6.notes: No price found. Only one fact fetched; thin. Reached by a 2.6 km causeway visible only at low tide (NetEase snippet, not fetched), so unverified.

lianyungang-7.name: Fenghuangwan Beach
lianyungang-7.bio: Bathing beach on the coast northeast of Lianyungang, reached by Xinpu-Lianyun train and then bus.
lianyungang-7.notes: Wikivoyage lists no price. Hold for cost. Placement coordinates null; needs pin.

lianyungang-8.name: Lianyungang Museum
lianyungang-8.bio: The city's main museum, on Chaoyang Road East in Haizhou District, with local history exhibits.
lianyungang-8.notes: Single listing. Closed Mondays per Wikivoyage. Placement coordinates null; needs pin.

xishuang-lake.name: Xishuang Lake
xishuang-lake.bio: Wetland park and 4A scenic lake in Donghai County with a lily park, a 17-arch bridge and a crystal tower.
xishuang-lake.notes: Xinhua article gives no fee. Hold for cost.
